nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This will be awesome! I've already thought up a bunch of campaign slogans!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ben Kale, your next President! `Kale` to the Chief!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben Kale, your next President! [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale[/i][/color] to the Chief!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please stop.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or... Big Ben! He isn't a large British clock, but he knows the time! Time to vote for him that is!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. Worse!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Kale!` Just like the vegetable! He might make you throw up, but he sure is good for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale![/i][/color] Just like the vegetable! He might make you throw up, but he sure is good for you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... That one's not as solid.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think you should forget about slogans, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That bad?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You haven't even been nominated yet!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, I know you've done `a lot` to increase your rep! You've earned a spot at the Center Table, you've thrown some totes epic parties!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I know you've done [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] to increase your rep! You've earned a spot at the Center Table, you've thrown some totes epic parties!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've started dating `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I've started dating [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That helps...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But if you're ever going to become President, you've got to have an online presence! You need Faceplace friends first!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay. How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously? `How` are we dating?
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously? [color=#3b78e2][i]How[/i][/color] are we dating?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you! I don't use Faceplace. Do I just ask people to be my Faceplace friend?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aaah! No! Don't do that! `Never` ask directly!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaah! No! Don't do that! [color=#3b78e2][i]Never[/i][/color] ask directly!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do I do then?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You mingle. After you've hit it off, `then,` and only then, do you send them a Friend Invite.
nodes.text_bbcode: You mingle. After you've hit it off, [color=#3b78e2][i]then,[/i][/color] and only then, do you send them a Friend Invite.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is going to take a long time, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not if you do it right! The best thing about Faceplace is that if you snag a friend who's already popular, you'll get Friend Invites from all of `their` friends!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not if you do it right! The best thing about Faceplace is that if you snag a friend who's already popular, you'll get Friend Invites from all of [color=#3b78e2][i]their[/i][/color] friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where do I start?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do you think? With the most popular couples at Twin Branches!
Ben has failed.
Luckily, everyone gets a second chance!
Try again, only this time think twice before refusing the Presidency!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'd rather stop fixating on being popular and just not worry about Faceplace at all, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Going after popularity was important, Jess, but why did I do it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, I've pranked Wilson High, I've thrown a Best Party Ever, I've sat at the Center Table...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And only now do I realize that I did it all for you... I love you, Jess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-huh, that's nice. So, you `don't` care about being popular anymore?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh, that's nice. So, you [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] care about being popular anymore?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not at all... I might even go back to studying regularly. I've already started to spend more time with the nerds!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As long as we're together, I don't care about being popular!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh-huh. About that... There's something I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go on... You can tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Where do I begin? How about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I've been manipulating you, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This whole time... I've been manipulating you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I more or less planned your entire break up with Denni, and everything I've done since has been another step in getting you to become President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I can't believe what I'm hearing!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Believe it, Ben! It feels so super good to get this out in the open! You have no idea!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But after Denni, we kissed in your room... Don't tell me that was fake!
For an instant, there's a flicker of something deep in Jessica's eye, a twinge of vulnerability...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It didn't mean anything, Ben! It was all so that you could become President!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why is that so important?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Because, Ben! I would totes have all the benefits of being First Lady! Trips to exotic places, my own office, political power!
Ben recoils in horror!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who are you?!
Jessica cackles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm just a girl, Ben. And I'm going to get what I want...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I was going to get it `with or without you...` And it looks like you've chosen `without...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I was going to get it [color=#3b78e2][i]with or without you...[/i][/color] And it looks like you've chosen [color=#3b78e2][i]without...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We're broken up! And just so you know, I'll be posting all of the horrible things you've done to me on Faceplace!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I haven't done anything horrible to you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Once it's on Faceplace, it's real! Bye-bye now!
Well, that didn't go well at all! It's very clear...
Ben's phone buzzes!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! I just got a bunch of Friend Invites from ex-Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I barely got any Friend Invites from any of the Spartans... I guess my plan didn't work that well...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I haven't gotten any Friend Invites from any of the Spartans... I guess my plan didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And none from Tom...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No reply from Chad...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No reply from Mark...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, guys, keep studying... I just need to check on something...
Ben steps into the hall and checks Faceplace on his phone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I sent all of them Friend Invites...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I fail to see how supplying Tom with proper and correct tutelage will turn him into any more of a dullard than his teacher already has!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Apologies, sir, but it is for your own good!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... Let's start with Christopher Columbus's journey to America in 1492. This led to Europe's awareness of the New World and...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Ahem.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I believe the first European to reach America was an Englishman named Roger Jowly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no record of anyone named Roger Jowly. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: It happened. Have you not heard of his ship, the Jowly Roger?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Don't you mean the `Jolly` Roger?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Don't you mean the [color=#e23b3b][i]Jolly[/i][/color] Roger?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I did not misspeak.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jeeves, I can't teach Tom if you're going to be contradicting everything I say!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Very well, then! You won't be teaching Tom at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're going to scramble Tom's brain! Look at him!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know what to believe anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ugh... Fine... Jeeves, `you` teach him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... Fine... Jeeves, [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] teach him!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: A... A cheater?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! It's wrong to give someone else the answers! Do you want to teach Tom that it's okay to break the rules?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No, but... He's not getting the right answers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Tom's certified teacher is supplying one set of information while you, with all your life experience, are supplying another set...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Isn't it up to Tom to learn which information is correct and which is false?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You're not suggesting that my information is false, are you?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Good! Then... Then I guess Tom can figure out just which of his teacher's lessons are erroneous...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you'll let Tom be taught on his own?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jeeves?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Very well.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Jeeves...
Ben spends a little more time teaching Tom history, while Jeeves painfully tries not to interject...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right, Tom and History...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...And Jeeves.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jeeves, why have you been giving Tom answers?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'm afraid his teacher is sorely mistaken with regard to information touted by him as 'facts'!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, what?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: The man claims that Franklin Roosevelt had polio and was confined to a wheelchair!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. He was.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: False! I played golf with the man on numerous occasions! He was a fearsome hitter. In fact, he and I hammered out The New Deal after a full round at Augusta.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How old are you?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Never mind that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... How have you been feeding Tom answers in class?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: With some old-fashioned spy equipment...
Jeeves nudges Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Er... Old-fashioned `normal` equipment.
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... Old-fashioned [color=#e23b3b][i]normal[/i][/color] equipment.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You can't keep giving Tom answers, Jeeves...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You might know everything, but if you keep doing this, you'll turn Tom into...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's how much the item costs.
Chad inputs some numbers into his phone's calculator app...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Four dollars!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's the number I told you!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, and it's the number I came up with using my phone! I win! Math is dumb!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... I guess you don't need math...
Ben hands Chad back his $100 bill.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow... That backfired...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's how much you've got right there, right?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah.
Chad inputs some numbers into his phone's calculator app...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Hmm... This says I owe `six` dollars instead of four.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... This says I owe [color=#e23b3b][i]six[/i][/color] dollars instead of four.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, well, I guess I calculated wrong! You owe me six dollars, please!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Wait... Something's not right! You tricked me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what if I did?! Didn't I prove that you need to understand how math works?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess so... Fine, I'll accept a few pointers, I guess.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm glad you're so willing to learn...
Ben spends the next few minutes giving Chad some further instructions in math.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if I really helped Mark out at all...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All right... I think you know what to do now. Just go through and do the same thing to the rest of these sentences, and you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aww, man. I hate English.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We all do, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: T-H-E-I-R.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You are too smart, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I try.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Thanks, man! English is stupid easy with a tutor!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: T-H-E-Y apostrophe R-E.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Really? Doesn't that mean, 'Adult giraffes are taller than they are babies'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Yeah, it does.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hahaha! { I schooled the tutor! I schooled the tutor! {

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Hmm, I was thinking that.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Giraffes `are` probably taller than most were-babies...
nodes.text_bbcode: Giraffes [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] probably taller than most were-babies...

nodes.text: Nearby, Jeeves gives Ben a withering look...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait wait wait... I'm sorry, it should be 'their' babies, T-H-E-I-R.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was just messing with you...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Man, and people say `I` suck.
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, and people say [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] suck.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's just one problem left. You want to change 'there babies' to...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Should it be 'giraffen'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... No... Wait...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: The problem is that you should not say 'more tall'. The word is 'taller'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right... I knew that.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Why can't I just have the old French dude for my tutor?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: French?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't worry, I just slipped up for a second...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You want to change that to...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Taller?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There you go.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Booyah! Backbutter is so smooth!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's a problem with how you've written...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: You're wrong, dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Mark, that was a little harsh of me...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: No kidding, dog.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I knows it!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Uh, sorry to intervene, Master Ben, but I believe the sentence is still incorrect in a number of ways...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Aww, man! My genius tutor doesn't even know how to do this! I don't have a chance!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hold on...
Ben looks at the sentence again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Ha ha! I don't even need you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, it's still not quite right...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have I just been `obeying` Jessica?
nodes.text_bbcode: Have I just been [color=#e23b3b][i]obeying[/i][/color] Jessica?

nodes.text: Ben's phone beeps, and he sees the time on his phone!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! I completely lost track of time! I've gotta go tutor the Spartans!
Ben arrives at the library, where several ex-Spartans are waiting for him...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I bet if I help these guys out, I can get them to accept my Friend Invites! I could become Faceplace friends with `all` the Spartans!
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet if I help these guys out, I can get them to accept my Friend Invites! I could become Faceplace friends with [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] the Spartans!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: What's the point of this? I don't know if you know, but my mom's a Senator, so I'm pretty sure I don't need tutoring.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't understand what we're doing here. We already know everything.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You guys are so embarrassing. Can I not be associated with them?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Tom would appreciate it, Master Kale, if he not be associated with this... Flotsam.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow. I definitely underestimated how difficult this is going to be...
Ben looks through a folder...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let me see...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mark, you need help in English. This says you're struggling with basic grammar.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Pssh. Nah. We got this.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. And Chad, you need help in Algebra.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: It'd be a lot easier if Ms. Prez just coughed up information on what X is! She tells me it's `'unknown'` but she knows! She knows!
nodes.text_bbcode: It'd be a lot easier if Ms. Prez just coughed up information on what X is! She tells me it's [color=#e23b3b][i]'unknown'[/i][/color] but she knows! She knows!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I actually think you're right about that... And Tom, you're struggling in History...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because, according to this report, you've been fed answers from your manservant.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is this true?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well...
Jeeves nudges him.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: We haven't the foggiest.
Tom turns back to Ben and nods.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... We haven't the foggiest.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I think I see why you're all here. Let's get started...
Ben looks at a paper on Mark's desk.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You wrote a sentence here...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'The adult giraffes is more tall then there babees.'

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Pretty sick, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes, but probably not the way you mean it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How would you fix it?

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh...
Mark looks over the sentence and changes it... Ben rereads it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Adult giraffes are more tall than there babies.'

nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.text: Ah... I get it. We're cool when we're playing video games or talking about wrestling...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But when it comes to something real... I'm not your friend.

nodes.text: Sure, pal.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: See ya.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I didn't mean for him to take that so personally...
Spencer calls over his shoulder as he walks away...

nodes.text: Just make sure you're `listening` to Jessica and not `obeying` her, Kale.

nodes.text: Oh... You did?

nodes.text: So... I'm wrong because I don't like something as violent as football?

nodes.text: It's one thing not to like something, but you're going out of your way to bash it!

nodes.text: I saw this one about a mutant pig with a chainsaw who...

nodes.text: I... I made it up.

nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... That is the most inaccurate description of football [color=#e23b3b][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So my facts are a little off... It's still violent!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It can be... But it can also be fun and inspiring and beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There's nothing like outmaneuvering a defender, turning your head just in time to catch a perfect spiral from your quarterback...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then racing across a field toward the end zone to the cheers of hundreds of fans!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And whenever I see Howard do that, I feel proud... Not only because I'm his girlfriend, but because I go to the school he represents!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Once you understand how the game works, it's a lot easier to understand all those things that make it fun!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I never really thought about all that other stuff... I just focused on the brutality.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry for getting all judgmental and out of line like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's okay! I kind of like the idea that I have an inner caveman!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And thanks, Ben, for calling me out like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... No problem!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, anyway, Nick, football. Uh, let's talk about that. Please.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's there to say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fun!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's also a construct of a society that thrives on violence. I don't see the value in a bunch of guys tearing each other's heads off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! I've spent a lot of time playing football!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And I'm sure you're really good at channeling your inner caveman, but it's not for me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Inner caveman?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Hold up! I think the problem is that Nick...

options.label: Isn't communicating what he really feels.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you take away all the stressful stuff, you're left with a time of the year when family and friends can get together and love each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that sounds really nice. Is that what you meant, Nick?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: More or less...
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Thanks! Nice save, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was nothing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eating?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, if there are no carols, no decorations, and no gifts, what's left? Good eats!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Many of our impoverished don't even have enough food to sustain themselves during the holiday...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! I'll never eat again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh, I might have been wrong before, but I'm pretty sure Nick didn't mean, 'Don't eat,' $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can you like this guy, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's not always like this!
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't think things could get worse with Sam's cousin, but thanks for proving me wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: For?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For, you know, stuff?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's trying to get rid of all the stuff!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Would that be so bad?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahh! I can't hear this!
Nick turns his head so only Ben can hear him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I didn't think things could get worse with Sam's cousin, but thanks for proving me wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni hasn't accepted hers...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not surprised... She does `not` like me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not surprised... She does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, what do you expect?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: As fun as this is, I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I got nothing. I just don't want to talk to you anymore...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The feeling's mutual.
Afterward, Ben meets up with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I sent Friend Invites out to them both...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: First, whatever you just said sounded lame...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And second, what's Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You seriously don't know?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You have the most sought-after online friendship and you don't even know what Faceplace is? How is that possible?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Because I have a life, Tweed. Computers are just things I hang my jacket on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh, you know what? My sister does all that computer stuff for me. She's always asking me if I think certain people are cool...
Ben makes a sound of incredulous frustration...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Power-sliding aside, you've always been protective of her, and I can respect that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crap.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was going to make fun of you some more, but now it'll just make me look like a jerk.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll take that as a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: By the way, nice haircut, Tweed. It looks like you're wearing a brown mop for a toupee.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See how I did that? I went there anyway.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I saw.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But that's it. I don't like you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that `is` it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm really `glad` we had this talk, Ben.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, I'm really [color=#3b78e2][i]glad[/i][/color] we had this talk, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm guessing that's sarcasm.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why don't you ask Jessica?
Nearby, Jessica makes eye contact with Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... That's great, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was just thinking about how much I wanted to hear about how happy you are with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Denni. I shouldn't have brought her up... I guess some of the wounds are still fresh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something like that...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Progress?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I kind of ditched them unintentionally in my quest for popularity.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But, after the Spartan Games, we're spending time together again...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Well, that's good. I always thought you belonged with them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you calling me a nerd?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! Are you denying that you are one?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. I don't think I could while keeping a straight face...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, uh...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: With Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was really hoping to avoid bringing her up... But yeah.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe we shouldn't talk about her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about you? How are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm good. I feel like I've made a lot of progress with...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How'd that go?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It went great! Thanks for asking!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: After the corruption at Spartan was exposed, the article got picked up by one of Centerscore's city-wide papers!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's really cool! You've always wanted to become a journalist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! I didn't even really think about it that way until now, but yeah... I `am` a journalist!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha! I didn't even really think about it that way until now, but yeah... I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] a journalist!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not to brag, but that makes me sound awesome!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. It does.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you mean my holiday vacation where I saw all the pictures of you and Jessica on her Faceplace account?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She... She posted those?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, and it looked like you two had a lot of fun!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Denni, I didn't realize...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't... Just... Let's drop it, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I never got to ask you about your...

nodes.prompt: I never got to ask you about your...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I never got to ask you about your...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean, since `I` broke up with `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, since [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] broke up with [color=#3b78e2][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, if you're going to be technical... Not since you broke up with me `the second time.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if you're going to be technical... Not since you broke up with me [color=#e23b3b][i]the second time.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? You're going there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I'm sorry... Forget that. Let me start over...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You'd better...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Tuesday? We didn't talk on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're joking, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Haha! I forgot how clever you are...
Ben and Jessica approach Denni and Colt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt! You never told me how you managed to beat that Spartan! What was his name? Perry? Gary?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You mean, Percy? That guy... What a toolbox!
Colt turns his attention away from Denni, and Jessica gives Ben the subtlest of winks.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's up? We haven't really talked very much since... You know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I know, since...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait a second... You don't still have feelings for Denni, do you?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? No! How could you even say that?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're acting weird, that's how!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well forgive me for acting weird when my current girlfriend is going to tag along while I try to be friendly to my ex-girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not exactly a normal situation!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just watch `how` friendly you are!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just watch [color=#3b78e2][i]how[/i][/color] friendly you are!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, don't worry about that. I'm not exactly in a friendly mood anymore!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah yeah, come on!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You start with `her.` I'll distract Colt.
nodes.text_bbcode: You start with [color=#3b78e2][i]her.[/i][/color] I'll distract Colt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, I know... And Denni's your ex...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But if you go in there alone, you'll have to deal with Colt and Denni `at the same time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But if you go in there alone, you'll have to deal with Colt and Denni [color=#3b78e2][i]at the same time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If I go with you, I can distract Colt while you talk to Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You already thought this through?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sometimes I think I don't give you nearly as much credit as you deserve...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww! Come on!
The next day, Ben meets up with Jessica in the hallway.
Across the way, Colt and Denni are talking at Denni's locker.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't think this is a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni and I were dating not that long ago, and I don't think there's any chance in the world Colt would ever be my Faceplace friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He and I go together like peas and... And a pea-crushing machine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt and Denni are the new power couple of Twin Branches! The moment Denni changed her status to `Dating Colt...` Faceplace exploded!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt and Denni are the new power couple of Twin Branches! The moment Denni changed her status to [color=#3b78e2][i]Dating Colt...[/i][/color] Faceplace exploded!

nodes.text: Jessica brings up Faceplace on her phone and shows Ben all the comments about Colt and Denni on Denni's Faceplace page.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This comment is just the word 'Yes' over and over, with like a thousand exclamation marks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know. It's nauseating.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do people know all these details? Here, look at this post... This girl says Denni kissed Colt's knuckles!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do they say anything about us?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... They `love` us!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... They [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] us!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Anyway, the point is that even though Colt's Faceplace friendship will be tough to get, it's got diamond-level value!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And Denni's?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Also valuable. She pulls in the hard-to-get hipster and emo crowds... But Colt's the big fish... He reaches everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... You're coming?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yes! Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, not exactly... It's just that...

options.label: Denni and I used to date!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Colt, why don't you talk to Ben for a moment? I'd like some girl time with Denni.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, great. Girl time.
Jessica leads Denni away...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tweed? When did you get here?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I was just talking to...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. I didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What did you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just trying to... To patch things up between me and Denni, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, you pretty much blew it with the Hipster.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think it was just a lot of miscommunication...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Or... It could be that you're the kind of guy who gives `Jessica` the perfume you made for Denni...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or... It could be that you're the kind of guy who gives [color=#e23b3b][i]Jessica[/i][/color] the perfume you made for Denni...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I'm the kinda guy who saves her from danger by power-sliding my motorcycle under a helicopter before it explodes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just saying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Look, Colt, I'm not here to get into a chest-beating contest or anything like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm here to talk to you too, actually...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, there's nothing to patch up between `us,` Tweed. We don't like each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, there's nothing to patch up between [color=#e23b3b][i]us,[/i][/color] Tweed. We don't like each other.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know you don't like me, but...

options.label: I need you to friend me on Faceplace!
At least you're looking out for Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What about Colt?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing... I don't think Colt's going to accept my request anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why not? Wait... You didn't mention Faceplace, did you?
Spencer reaches out and takes Ben's phone from his hand.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yoink.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Faceplace? That's so lame. What are you doing, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying to get friends. Give me back my phone, or I'll scuff your shoes.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not funny! What's my `one` rule?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not funny! What's my [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] rule?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We do not talk about Fist Club?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh, right... Well I'm adding a second one... No threatening my shoes!
Spencer hands the phone back to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why do you suddenly care about Faceplace?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't tell anyone... But I'm going to run for President.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah? That's cool. You'll become, like, Mr. Popular.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait... I don't get it...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What does Faceplace have to do with being President?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica said I won't have a chance of becoming President as long as I have zero Faceplace friends...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jessica... Man, I should have known.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're whipped, bro. W-I-P-T.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on! You can't be `that` bad at spelling.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on! You can't be [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] bad at spelling.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Who needs spelling when you can just punch stuff?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's scarily logical, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I am `not` whipped!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I am [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] whipped!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You just told me it was her idea for you to get more Faceplace friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, to become President!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And running for President. That was your idea?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, no, that was hers too... But it's a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about this new look you've been sporting?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. It was her idea to make me over! Maybe I listen to her a lot, but that doesn't make me whipped!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just don't want her to leave me...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aww, man! I `know` you're not this lame! She asks you to jump, and you say 'How high?'
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, man! I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're not this lame! She asks you to jump, and you say 'How high?'

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What if she asks you to do something you don't want to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not going to happen!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What if it already has?
Ben pauses...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand... Why are you always doing whatever `she` wants?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't understand... Why are you always doing whatever [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] wants?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, next up... Chad and Algebra.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I don't need to do this! No one needs to know how to do math anymore!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: We've all got computers and phones that can do math for us!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, you think you don't need math?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine, then let's have a quick, real-life lesson in math...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I can teach Chad that not knowing `how` to use math will hurt him financially, he might pay attention!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I can teach Chad that not knowing [color=#e23b3b][i]how[/i][/color] to use math will hurt him financially, he might pay attention!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You got any money on you?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Just pocket change...
Chad pulls a $100 bill from his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! `That` is pocket change?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] is pocket change?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Let's just get on with the math lesson, all right?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine... Let's say you decide to buy something with your $100 bill.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It costs $40.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Pfft! Like anything `only` costs $40...
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! Like anything [color=#e23b3b][i]only[/i][/color] costs $40...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Anyway, here, I'll give you back $60.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: This is just a piece of paper that says $60!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't carry that kind of cash around, so pretend, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, wait! I forgot that there's a 10% tax. So, I'll just take four dollars from you...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Ha! Nice try! You think because I don't know math, you can trick me!
Chad whips out his phone and pulls up a calculator app...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Okay, let's see, um... I want to figure out how much I owe you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here's my chance to trick Chad...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: So I input an amount to tax which is... Uh... How much?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... You want to tax...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what do you say? Do you want to run for President this year or not?

nodes.prompt: Do you want to run for President?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you want to run for President?

nodes.text: Ben's phone buzzes again...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a text from Jessica! It says, 'meet me near Lyle statue. now.'
Ben starts to head toward the Lyle statue but stops himself!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's like Spencer said... `I'm obeying her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like Spencer said... [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm obeying her![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe being President is her idea, but it `is` a good one. I want to become President! I'm just going to do it `my` way, starting right now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe being President is her idea, but it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good one. I want to become President! I'm just going to do it [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] way, starting right now!

nodes.text: Ben sends a text back to Jessica: 'no. going to get friend invites from nerds.'
Ben's phone immediately rings!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She'll just have to call back later!
He ignores it and steps back into the library, passing Tom and Jeeves as they leave...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Done studying?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Thomas studies at his best at home without any distractions obscuring his thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I just wanted to update my status on Faceplace...
Inside, Ben looks around for a few minutes...
Then he walks over to where Chad and Mark are still studying...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys, have you seen any of the nerds? Normally, they're in here.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah, I saw them! They were all excited because of some nerdy monitor thing acting funny...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Any idea where they...
Suddenly, the ground tilts up, shaking violently! Books slide off of the desks! An entire bookcase falls to the ground with a deafening crash!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Mark
